definition: Autognostics is a new paradigm that describes the capacity for computer networks to be self-aware.
details: It is considered one of the major components of Autonomic Networking.

explainer.lead: Autognostics is the idea that a computer network can be aware of itself, rather than operating only as a collection of blindly followed rules. It matters because this self-awareness is considered a major component of autonomic networking, where networks take on more of their own management.

tiers.eli5: Imagine a toy train set that can notice how its own tracks and trains are doing, instead of waiting for you to check everything. Autognostics is a similar idea for computer networks: the network has some awareness of itself. This can help it become better at managing itself.
tiers.practitioner: Treat autognostics as a design principle for self-managing networks, not as a specific product or implementation. A design following it should give the network an understanding of its own condition, but that awareness alone does not provide diagnosis, repair, or safe decision-making. Those capabilities still need to be built and validated separately.
tiers.paperLevel: Autognostics denotes the capacity for computer networks to be self-aware. It is positioned as a major component of autonomic networking, so it describes one capability within that broader paradigm rather than the whole paradigm. The definition does not by itself specify a representation, algorithm, or guarantee of correct network behavior.

explainer.example: Consider a network whose connections are experiencing heavy traffic. An autognostic design would include awareness of that condition within the network itself; any subsequent response would belong to the broader autonomic networking system.

usedIn.name: Autonomic networking
usedIn.detail: Autognostics is considered one of this field's major components.

usedIn.name: Computer network design
usedIn.detail: It supplies the idea that a network should have awareness of itself.

explainer.intuition: A network that only follows instructions can act without understanding its own situation. Autognostics adds the idea of self-awareness, giving autonomic networking a foundation for network management informed by the network itself.
howItWorks: Start with a computer network whose own condition can be considered.
Give the network a capacity for awareness of itself.
Use that self-awareness as part of the network's autonomic behavior.
Keep self-awareness distinct from the wider tasks of managing the network.
explainer.whyItMatters: It identifies self-awareness as a building block for networks that manage themselves. That separates knowing one's own condition from merely executing fixed management instructions.
misconceptions: It does not mean human-like consciousness.
It is not a synonym for all of autonomic networking.
Self-awareness alone does not guarantee self-repair.
